page_title: Feed-grade blood plasma and hemoglobin | Intertekhkorm

hero_title: High-quality protein ingredients for the modern feed industry
about_p1: Intertekhkorm has been a reliable supplier of effective protein components and raw materials from EU manufacturers to Ukrainian livestock customers for 10 years.
about_p2: Our leading products have always been and remain hemoglobin and plasma — among the most valuable protein components of modern feed.
about_p3: We work directly with trusted European manufacturers, verify the accompanying documents for each batch and maintain personal contact with clients throughout every stage of supply.

p1_petfood_p1: ACTIPRO Plasma (feed-grade blood plasma) is a functional powdered protein ingredient produced by spray drying. In wet pet food production, plasma helps form a stable texture through its gelling, water-binding and emulsifying properties.
p1_petfood_p2: In dry food, the product can be used as a source of high-quality animal protein and natural immunoglobulins. ACTIPRO Plasma also helps improve feed palatability.
p1_livestock_p1: ACTIPRO Plasma is a source of highly digestible animal protein and natural bioactive components. It is used in feed formulations to improve palatability and support intestinal health.
p1_livestock_p2: Its natural content of bioactive glycoproteins and immunoglobulins (IgG) makes plasma powder a functional component of modern feeding programs.
p1_feat1: 70 ± 2% crude protein — a highly digestible animal protein source
p1_feat2: Improves feed palatability and supports gut health
p1_feat3: An irreversible gelling agent for wet pet food applications
p1_feat4: Spray-dried in accordance with Commission Regulation (EC) No 142/2011
p1_appearance_text: Form: powder. Colour: beige. pH: 7.5–9.5. Protein solubility in pepsin-HCl: over 98%. Bulk density: 0.55 g/cm³.
p1_packaging_text: 20 kg food-processing kraft bags with a polyethylene liner. Shelf life: 1 year from production date, stored in the original packaging at 10–30°C in dry conditions (<70% relative humidity).
p2_petfood_p1: ACTIPRO Hemoglobin (feed-grade blood hemoglobin) is a concentrated source of highly digestible animal protein produced by spray drying. It has a high organic iron content, a low phosphorus level and contains essential amino acids.
p2_petfood_p2: Hemoglobin powder can be used as a protein ingredient in dry food formulations and as a component that gives wet food its characteristic colour.
p2_livestock_p1: ACTIPRO Hemoglobin is used as a highly digestible source of animal protein and organic iron. It contains essential amino acids and has low levels of phosphorus and biogenic amines.
p2_livestock_p2: The high content of bioavailable iron makes hemoglobin powder a valuable feed component, particularly for animals with increased iron requirements.
p2_feat1: Very high protein content — around 92%, with high digestibility
p2_feat2: Low in phosphorus, rich in organic iron
p2_feat3: Suitable for dog, cat, pet bird, ferret and mink diets
p2_feat4: Spray-dried in accordance with Commission Regulation (EC) No 142/2011 and subject to TSE rules

p2_appearance_text: Form: powder. Colour: red-brown. pH: 8–10. Protein solubility in pepsin-HCl: over 98%. Density: 0.55 g/cm³.
p2_packaging_text: 25 kg food-processing kraft bags with a polyethylene liner or 900 kg big bags. Shelf life: 2 years from production date, stored in the original packaging at 10–30°C in dry conditions (<70% relative humidity).
